scope.question: Does a traceable lexicographic witness preserve Qurtubi's report that Abu Ubayd gave the specialized sense مثعب الحوض (cistern outlet/spout) for الصنبور?

scope.limitation: This checks the wording and attributed source in a later lexicon. It does not inspect Abu Ubayd's own work, establish transmission independence, authenticate a report, or authorize translation or publication.

finding.supported: Al-Jawhari's al-Sihah presents the same specialized cistern-outlet sense and explicitly says it was related from Abu Ubayd. This gives a traceable later lexicographic attestation of the attribution.

finding.attribution_boundary: Describe this only as al-Jawhari's later lexicographic attribution to Abu Ubayd; do not call it a direct Abu Ubayd quotation verified from his own work.
